## Get data

### Sötebasen

Correct for thawing / ethanol Using E. Ryvoll-Åsheims functions based on Sundin et al. 2019. Do some renaming and calculate teh Durif index baed on Eirks Ryvoll-Åsheims script for that

```{r}
# import data and convert 
sb_ind <- read.delim("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/SWEel-lhts/data/ÅlindividerSötebasen.csv", sep=";", dec=",", fileEncoding="Latin1") %>% convert_alsotebasen_thawed_sizes()

colnames(sb_ind)

# sb_ind2 %>%
#   mutate(sex = if_else(sex %in% c("m","f"), 1, NA)) %>%
#   filter(is.na(sex)) %>%
#   summarise(n(), .by(Plats)
#   distinct(Plats)

sb_ind2 <- sb_ind %>%
  rename(length = Längd_corr,
         weight = Vikt_corr,
         age = Ålder,
         sex = Kön,
         visual_stage = Stadium
         ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(length) & is.na(weight) & Åldersprov == "Nej")) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  # get the eye diameter and pectoral fin measurement and take the mean to make sure we use all individuals that have a meassuremnt.
  mutate(diameter_eye = mean(c(VäD_corr,HöD_corr), na.rm = TRUE),
         length_pectoral = mean(c(HöBr_corr,VäBr_corr), na.rm = TRUE),
         diameter_eye = if_else(is.nan(diameter_eye),NA,diameter_eye),
         length_pectoral = if_else(is.nan(length_pectoral),NA,length_pectoral)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Fix coordinates. These uses "." as dec
  mutate(across(c(WGS84_E_Vatten, WGS84_N_Vatten, WGS84_N_Plats, WGS84_E_Plats), readr::parse_number),
         # when Plats coords are missing, we use the Vatten name. ~800 eels lacks coords but many of h
         lon = if_else(is.na(WGS84_E_Plats), WGS84_E_Vatten, WGS84_E_Plats),
         lat = if_else(is.na(WGS84_N_Plats), WGS84_N_Vatten, WGS84_N_Plats),
         db = "sb",
         year = if_else(Årtal1 == Årtal2, Årtal1, year(as_date(FångstDatum)))
         
         ) %>%
  # calculate Durif according to Eirik Ryvoll-Åsheims script
  mutate(durif_stage = stage_durif(length,weight,diameter_eye,length_pectoral,descr=F))
  
```


#### Durif vs Visual
```{r}
# check how durif correspond to visual
sb_ind2 %>% summarise(n = n(), .by = c(durif_stage,visual_stage)) %>% arrange(-n)
  
# check densities of durif stages vs visual for females
# lump/condense stages
sb_ind2 %>%
  drop_na(durif_stage,visual_stage,sex) %>%
  filter(sex %in% c("f"),
         visual_stage %in% c("Blankål","Halvblank ål","Gulål")) %>%
  mutate(redDurif_stage = case_when(durif_stage %in% c("I","FII","MII") ~ "I, MII & FII",
                                    durif_stage %in% c("FIII") ~ "FIII",
                                    durif_stage %in% c("FIV","FV") ~ "FIV & FV",
                                    #durif_stage %in% c("I") & sex == "m" ~ "m<3",
                                    .default = durif_stage)) %>%
  #summarise(n = n(), .by = c(durif_stage,visual_stage)) %>% arrange(visual_stage) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(length, color = redDurif_stage), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density(aes(length, fill = visual_stage), color = NA, alpha = 0.2) 
  

```

## Join data and fix errors
```{r}
# can there be dupes between the dbs?
# dupes <- c(kul_ind2$Ind_id,sb_ind2$IndividID)[duplicated(c(kul_ind2$Ind_id,sb_ind2$IndividID))]
# kul_ind2 %>%
#   filter(Ind_id %in% dupes) %>% select(length,age,db) %>% bind_cols(sb_ind2 %>% filter(IndividID %in% dupes) %>% select(length,age,db)) # likely not

# join the sb and kul data
cols <- c("length","weight","age","lat","lon","sex","visual_stage","durif_stage","db","year")
df <- sb_ind2 %>% 
  select(all_of(cols), VattenNamn,diameter_eye,length_pectoral) %>% 
  bind_rows(kul_ind2 %>% 
            mutate(durif_stage = NA) %>%
            select(all_of(cols), Lokal)) %>%
  mutate(sex = ifelse(sex %in% c("f","Hona"), "female", 
                      if_else( sex %in% c("m","Hane"), "male", NA)),
         ind_id = row_number()) %>%
  # set one weight == 0 to NA
  mutate(weight = if_else(weight == 0, NA, weight))

# id. weird looking data based on le cren, eye diam and pectoral length
ab <- df %>%
  drop_na(weight,length) %>%
  lm(data = ., log(weight) ~ log(length)) %>%
  tidy() 
ap <- df %>%
  drop_na(length_pectoral,length) %>%
  lm(data = ., log(length_pectoral) ~ log(length)) %>%
  tidy() 

ol <- df %>%
  drop_na(weight,length,length_pectoral) %>%
  filter(!weight == 0) %>%
  mutate(a = ab$estimate[1], 
         b = ab$estimate[2],
         bp = ap$estimate[2],
         ap = ap$estimate[1]) %>%
  mutate(lecren = weight/exp(a + b*log(length)),
         pecindex = length_pectoral/exp(ap + bp*log(length))
         ) %>%
  # mutate(lc_outlie = if_else(lecren < quantile(lecren, 0.00025) | lecren > quantile(lecren, 0.99975),1,0),
  #        pi_outlie = if_else(pecindex < quantile(pecindex, 0.00025) | pecindex > quantile(pecindex, 0.99975),1,0))
mutate(lc_outlie = if_else(lecren < 0.3 | lecren > 4,1,0),
       pi_outlie = if_else(pecindex < 0.3 | pecindex > 4,1,0))

#pec and lecren outlier
ol %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(length,weight, color = factor(lc_outlie))) +
ol %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(length,length_pectoral, color = factor(pi_outlie)))

# odd data on eye diam 
df %>%
  drop_na(diameter_eye) %>%
  mutate(outlie = if_else(diameter_eye > 200,1,0)) %>%
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(aes(length,diameter_eye, color = factor(outlie)))

# remove or change value of these outilers in the data
col <- ol %>% filter(lc_outlie == 1) %>% pull(ind_id)
pol <- ol %>% filter(pi_outlie == 1) %>% pull(ind_id)

df2 <- df %>% 
  mutate(diameter_eye = if_else(diameter_eye > 200,NA,diameter_eye)) %>%
  mutate(length_pectoral = if_else(ind_id %in% pol,NA,length_pectoral)) %>%
  filter(!ind_id %in% col) 

```

## Retrieve spatial info

```{r}
# make data spatial object
df_sf <- st_as_sf(df2 %>% drop_na(lat,lon), coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326,  remove = FALSE)

re <- open_dataset("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/DIASPARA/Habitat_db/refeel/", format = "parquet")
ca <- open_dataset("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/DIASPARA/Habitat_db/catchments/", format = "parquet")

# coastal polygon and sea area (Norra/Södra Östersjön, Bottenviken, Västerhavet). From https://www.dataportal.se/datasets/78_7502.
read_sf("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/SWEel-lhts/Havsomraden_2016/Havsomraden_2016.shp") %>%
  st_transform(dst = 4326) %>%
  group_by(TYP_NFS06) %>%
  #distinct()
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = TYP_NFS06), color =NA, show.legend = FALSE)

# basins VH or OS
ba_sf <- read_sf("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/SWEel-lhts/Havsomraden_2016/Havsomraden_2016.shp") %>%
  st_transform(dst = 4326) %>%
  mutate(sea_basin = case_when(NAME %in% c("Del av Kattegatts utsjövatten","Del av Skagerraks utsjövatten") ~ "VH",
                               COMP_AUTH == "VH" ~ "VH",
                               .default = "OS")) %>%
  group_by(sea_basin) %>%
  summarise() %>%
  ungroup() #%>%
  #rename(sea_basin = COMP_AUTH) %>%
  # rename the NA polygon to get fix these later
  #mutate(sea_basin = if_else(is.na(sea_basin), "FIX", sea_basin))
saveRDS(ba_sf, paste0(home,"/R/prep_data/basin_polygons.rds"))

# haros
haros <- read_sf("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/SWEel-lhts/Huvudavrinnigsomrade shapefile/HARO.shp") %>% 
  st_transform(3006) %>% 
  rename(haro = text) 
saveRDS(haros, paste0(home,"/R/prep_data/haro_polygons.rds"))

ba_sf %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = sea_basin), color =NA)

# # sea areas
sa_sf <- read_sf("/Users/vitl0001/Documents/Projects/SWEel-lhts/Havsomraden_2016/Havsomraden_2016.shp") %>%
  st_transform(dst = 4326) %>%
  group_by(TYP_NFS06) %>%
  summarise() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(sea_area = TYP_NFS06) %>%
  filter(!sea_area == "Ingår ej i typningen")
  
# refeel countries
co_sf <- re %>%
  collect() %>%
  filter(are_lev_code %in% "Country") %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(geom_polygon), crs = 4326) %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry", crs = 4326)

# catchments hydrosheds
ca_sf <- ca %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(shape, EWKB = TRUE, crs = 4326),
         main_catch = main_bas) %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry") %>%
  select(main_catch) %>%
  group_by(main_catch) %>%
  summarise() %>%
  ungroup()

#save for plotting
saveRDS(ca_sf, paste0(home,"/R/prep_data/catchment_polygons.rds"))

# get basin and sea_area of each main catchment to join in sea_basin via catchment instead of coordinate
ca_sb <- ca %>%
  collect() %>%
  mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(shape, EWKB = TRUE, crs = 4326),
         main_catch = main_bas) %>%
  filter(next_down == 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geometry") %>%
  st_join(ba_sf %>% st_transform(4326), st_nearest_feature) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(main_catch,sea_basin)
  
# join in country info and drop non SE data points, use sweref99 as planar transformation for the join
df_co <- df_sf %>%
  st_transform(3006) %>%
  st_join(co_sf %>% st_transform(3006) %>% select(are_code), join = st_nearest_feature) %>%
  rename(country = are_code) %>%
  filter(country == "SE")

# set marine to those that intersects with the basins and join in sea_area
df_coba <- df_co %>%
  st_transform(3006) %>%
  st_join(ba_sf %>% st_transform(3006), join = st_intersects) %>%
  mutate(marine = if_else(is.na(sea_basin), "no", "yes"))

# one obs is outside the marine defined by the marine polygon 
plot_map_Nord +
  geom_point(data = df_coba %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = 32633), aes(X*1000, Y*1000, color = marine), size = 0.1)
# make this marine
df_coba <- df_coba %>%
  mutate(marine = if_else(lat < 56 & lon > 15, "yes", marine),
         sea_basin = if_else(lat < 56 & lon > 15, "OS", sea_basin))

# assign basin and sea area to marine individuals anduse st_nearest_feature
df_coba_mar <- df_coba %>%
  filter(marine == "yes") %>%
  st_join(sa_sf %>% st_transform(3006), join = st_nearest_feature)

plot_map_Nord +
  geom_point(data = df_coba_mar %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = 32633), aes(X*1000, Y*1000, color = sea_area, shape = sea_basin), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.1)

# add in catchment, haro and basin to inland individuals (not caught in marine areas)
df_cobaca_inland <- df_coba %>%
  filter(marine == "no") %>% 
  select(-sea_basin) %>%
  st_transform(3006) %>% 
  st_join(haros %>% select(haro) %>% st_transform(3006), join = st_intersects) %>%
  st_join(ca_sf %>% select(main_catch) %>% st_transform(3006), join = st_nearest_feature) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  left_join(ca_sb, join_by(main_catch == main_catch))

# join the inland and marine data
df_all <- df_cobaca_inland %>%
  bind_rows(df_coba_mar) %>%
  as_tibble() 

```

## Data points in spatial units, catchments and basins
```{r}
plot_map_Nord +
  geom_sf(data = ca_sf %>% filter(main_catch %in% df_cobaca_inland$main_catch), aes(fill = factor(main_catch)), color = NA,  alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data = df_all %>% 
               add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = 32633), aes(X*1000, Y*1000, color = factor(sea_basin)) , size = 0.1, ) +
  labs(caption = "color is spatial unit")

plot_map_Nord +
  #geom_sf(data = ca_sf %>% filter(main_catch %in% df_cobaca_inland$main_catch), aes(fill = factor(main_catch)), color = NA,  alpha = 0.3)  +
  geom_point(data = df_all %>%
               mutate(Habitat = if_else(marine == "no", "Inland", "Marine")) %>%
               #filter(spat.unit == "Ö Sydkustens kustvatten" | is.na(spat.unit)) %>%
               add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = 32633), aes(X*1000, Y*1000, color = Habitat), size = 0.1) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(title.position = "top")) +
  labs(color = "") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.18, 0.80))

```
